snippet.title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In a medieval land where magic is rare, finding a mysterious crystal sets off an unexpected chain of events for Tobias and his younger brother. Tobias must find a way to protect his loved ones — but it seems there are dark forces at play, and other people are looking for the crystal…

Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift is a dark point-and-click adventure game with focus on a deep and captivating story.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620350/Two_Realms_Whispers_from_the_Rift/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=steam&utm_content=announcement_trailer_text

Story / Direction / SFX & Music: Jaromír Janisch
Graphics / Art / Animations: Tomáš Létal
Character voices: ElevenLabs
